title.title: Finite symmetric tensor categories fibre over Verlinde ones
title.subtitle: Claim: in characteristic $p$, each finite symmetric tensor category has a fibre functor to some $\mathrm{Ver}_{p^n}$

plain: Every finite symmetric 'algebra of shapes' in characteristic $p$ maps faithfully into a known model

panels.caption: the higher Verlinde tower, each one inside the next

beats.text: In characteristic 0, Deligne: vector spaces and super vector spaces suffice
In characteristic $p$ new targets appear: the Verlinde categories $\mathrm{Ver}_{p^n}$
The claim: every finite symmetric tensor category maps into one of them

steps: Build a 'higher Frobenius' functor from special tilting modules
Choose the target by a rank test
That gives a fibre functor to a Verlinde category

achievement.label: Benson–Etingof–Ostrik conjecture, finite case
achievement.note: Finite categories only, including $p = 2$; moderate growth is not claimed

verify.detail: No Lean link established for this family; a 26-page paper
verify.ourCheck: We read the claim and the review; we did not check the proof

voice.text: In characteristic p new Verlinde categories appear; B E O predicted no others are needed.
A higher Frobenius functor, aimed by a rank test, gives the fibre functor.
Claimed: true for every finite category.

sources.quote: Coulembier–Etingof–Ostrik (Annals 2023, 'On Frobenius exact symmetric tensor categories') proved fibre functors to Ver_p for Frobenius-exact categories
Every finite symmetric tensor category over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p > 0 (including p = 2) admits a fibre functor
Finite case only (moderate-growth general case not claimed). 26 pp.
